title: Exactly Three-Literal Tseitin Conversion
statement: Let $n$, $w$ be natural numbers and let $$ be a CNF formula on $n$ variables. Applying the width-$w$ Tseitin conversion and then the exactly-three-literal conversion produces a CNF formula on $n+(w-3).+3$ variables, where $.$ is the number of clauses in $$.
caveat: The component conversion definitions are not supplied, so their constructions cannot be described beyond the names reflected by the declaration.
